name: de Bruijn family H_t and Dyson zero ODE
statement: H_t(x)=int_0^inf e^{t u^2} Phi(u) cos(xu) du, H_0(x)=xi(1/2+ix/2)/8 (doubled coordinates, zeros at 2*gamma). dH/dt=-H_xx (backward heat); real zeros obey dx_k/dt=2 sum_{m!=k} 1/(x_k-x_m), repulsive for increasing t.

name: Conjugate closure of the H_t zero set at every real t
statement: Phi real, even, positive, decaying like exp(-pi e^{4u}) gives H_t real-even entire for every real t (t<0 included), so its zero multiset is closed under z->conj z and z->-z. Per-t structure, no RH input; holds equally on the backward-heat control.

name: Field term of an off-line conjugate pair is real
statement: For real x and omitted pair y=sigma+i tau, conj y: -2[1/(x-y)+1/(x-conj y)] = -4(x-sigma)/((x-sigma)^2+tau^2). The omitted-zero field error e_k(t) in the Dyson ODE is real at every t whether or not any zero is on the line.

name: Telescoping gap kernel and projection domination
statement: Gap-difference kernel of an omitted zero y: Delta_l(y)=2 g_l/((x_l-y)(x_{l+1}-y)); pair: |Delta_l|<=4 g_l/(|x_l-y||x_{l+1}-y|). Since |x-y|>=|x-Re y|, an off-line zero with Re y outside [x_l,x_{l+1}] is dominated by the on-line zero at its projection; RvM counts cover it.

name: Straddle exclusion from an argument-principle-complete zero list
statement: If the first N zeros are a complete verified listing (N(x_N)=N, all real), every unlisted zero has Re y > x_N or Re y < 0, so none straddles a window gap; the only bad case for projection domination (bound 4 g_l/tau^2) cannot occur at t=0.

name: Contribution bound for hypothetical off-line zeros above verified height
statement: With T_ver=3.0001753328e12 (Platt-Trudgian), zeros off the line lie at horizontal distance > 2.9994e12 from any window gap and contribute epsOffline <= 2(log(T_ver/2pi)+1)/(pi T_ver)=5.9185e-12 to every eps'(l); 4.1e6 times below the smallest realised record-pair eps 2.43e-5.

name: Two-sided field-Lipschitz lemma of the field-channel reroute
statement: Zero-gap comparison under the backward Dyson flow needs only |e_{l+1}-e_l| <= eps' g_l for the omitted-zero field error, in both comparison branches; no sign or repulsion of the perturbation enters. Realness plus magnitude suffice (imp-3933 lemma class).

name: Displacement residual of the eps' certificate
statement: Bound, from t=0 table data, the instantaneous complex distances |x_l(t)-y(t)| between window zeros and omitted zeros over the whole backward-flow horizon (spectator real zeros may pair into complex). Realness and kernel structure are closed; this distance quantification is open.

name: Local jet lemma: real zeros split real under increasing t
statement: At a real zero of multiplicity 2m, dH/dt=-H_xx gives the jet e^{-s d^2}x^{2m}, a scaled Hermite polynomial with 2m simple real roots for s>0 and none for s<0 (m=2: x^4-12 s x^2+12 s^2). Conjugate pairs land; real zeros never leave as t increases.

name: de Bruijn Theorem 13 landing rate
statement: Zeros of H_{t0} in |Im z|<=Delta lie in |Im z|<=sqrt(max(Delta^2-2(t-t0),0)) at time t; all real by t0+Delta^2/2. With a certified zero-free strip this gives Lambda<=t0+Delta^2/2, the architecture of Polymath15 0.22 and Platt-Trudgian 0.2.

name: Window winding number is monotone along the flow
statement: W(t)=(1/2)#{sign changes of H_t on [a,b]} is non-decreasing in t absent boundary flux, jumping +1 per conjugate-pair landing. Classical consequence of the jet lemma and Theorem 13; time-reversed it is the 'winding Lyapunov' of imp-2696.

name: Gaussian convolution of H_0 is the exact flow at negative time
statement: Convolving H_0 with a Gaussian of width sqrt(2 tau) equals H_{-tau} (Fourier multiplier e^{-tau u^2}); in the repo ordinate gamma=x/2 this is t=-4 tau_repo. Checked against the exact integral: relative deviation 2e-9 (tau=0.5), 6e-9 (tau=2).

name: Winding/topological route re-derives the 0.2 architecture only
statement: Lower side: Lambda>0 iff RH false, and a window collision at t=-c certifies only Lambda>-c. Upper side: monotone winding plus landing rate is the existing Lambda<=t0+Delta^2/2 method; no improvement without more verified height or barrier input. Obstruction map rows G7, F3.

name: Exact H_t collision times in the window x in [20,104]
statement: Real-zero count of H_t: 10 for t>=-1.75, 8 at t=-2, 6 at -4, 4 at -6, 2 at -20 (pair mergers only). First collision (gamma_9,gamma_10) at t_c=-1.8837 versus two-body -(2 dgamma)^2/8=-1.5641; d(g^2)/dt about 5.78 versus 8; retardation factors 1.20 and 1.26.

name: Widening the window adds boundary in-flux under backward flow
statement: Extending the window beyond x=104 lets a zero enter from x>112 as early as t about -3.6, before most merges, which stops order-continuation of the collision sequence; the base window [20,104] has no boundary event in the tested t-range.

name: Calogero-Moser energy growth at the backward collision threshold
statement: In the Calogero-Moser realisation of the zero flow the only boundary is the backward-flow collision threshold; H_CM is not conserved there and increases with dH_CM/dtau about 80/gap^4 (imp-862). The monotone real-zero count re-derives Lambda>=0. Obstruction map row P31.

name: Kinetic curvature term equals (log zeta)''(2 sigma)
statement: T_zpo(sigma)=sum_p (log p)^2 p^{-2 sigma}/(1-p^{-2 sigma})^2 = (log zeta)''(2 sigma), the primon-gas specific-heat kernel at beta=2 sigma: C_v(beta)=beta^2 (log zeta)''(beta). Termwise differentiation of the Euler product, Re s>1.

name: Divergence law of the kinetic term at sigma -> 1/2+
statement: With u=2 sigma-1: T_zpo=1/u^2-c0+c1 u+O(u^2), c0=gamma^2+2 gamma_1=0.18754623, c1=3 gamma_2+6 gamma gamma_1+2 gamma^3=0.10337726. The divergence at sigma=1/2 is the pole of zeta at s=1 pulled back through beta=2 sigma; it carries Stieltjes constants and no zero data.

name: Hagedorn boundary law at beta -> 1+
statement: With v=beta-1: U(beta)=-(log zeta)'(beta)=1/v-gamma+O(v); C_v v^2=1+2v+O(v^2). No equilibrium phase for beta<1; T=1 is a limiting temperature (Bost-Connes KMS symmetry breaking at beta=1). Sees only the pole.

name: Prime-truncated kinetic term at sigma=1/2
statement: T_P(1)=sum_{p<=P}(log p)^2 p^{-1}/(1-p^{-1})^2 grows as (log P)^2/2+offset(P), offset(1e7)=-0.18389, drifting toward about -c0=-0.18755. The finite-prime Hamiltonian is finite at sigma=1/2 only through truncation.

name: Convexity of the bridge Hamiltonian at sigma=1/2 has no N -> infinity limit
statement: T_N(sigma,t)=sum_{p<=p_N}(1/2)log p(|H_p(s)|^2+|H_p(1-s)|^2) at t=14.134725: d^2T_N/dsigma^2 at sigma=1/2 is 19.2, 259.3, -77.2, -173.7, +1320.3, +2869.3 for N=10,100,400,800,1600,3200. Sign flips with growing amplitude; finite-stage convexity does not pass to the limit.

name: sigma=1/2 as a phase boundary only in complex temperature
statement: zeta is smooth through sigma=1/2 on the real axis (zeta(1/2)=-1.4603545), so no real-beta transition exists there. The Fisher zeros of the primon partition function are the nontrivial zeros; 'condensation on Re beta=1/2' is RH restated and gives no lever.

name: No critical coupling inside 1/2 < sigma < 1
statement: A fine survey of phase metrics (imp-2323) found all of them smooth in the open strip (1/2,1); the bulk order-parameter route is recorded as empirically dead.

name: De-homogenised shear/pass correlation matrix R(s)
statement: On phi_j(tau)=(tau/U)^j: D_jj=int_0^U cosh(a tau)phi_j^2, H_jk=int_0^U sinh(a tau)phi_j phi_k, R_jk=H_jk/sqrt(D_jj D_kk); pass and shear forms are the even and odd parts of one exponential e^{a tau}. ||R||=Perron eigenvalue. Representative truncation, not the section-26 Gram.

name: K_a >= 0 residual (roadmap gap G7)
statement: Show ||Gpass^{-1/2} Gsym Gpass^{-1/2}|| <= 1 for the symmetric single-lag endpoint-Hankel Gram Gsym of section 26; needs a dominating passive core bounding the off-diagonal cross-terms. On the degree-4 representative truncation at (a,U)=(0.5,6): ||R||=4.617, off-diagonal Frobenius 4.082.

name: Shear obstruction depends on s = a*U only
statement: tau=U x gives R_jk=h_jk(s)/sqrt(d_j(s)d_k(s)), d_j=int_0^1 cosh(sx)x^{2j}dx, h_jk=int_0^1 sinh(sx)x^{j+k}dx. R is invariant under (a,U)->(a/lam,lam U): no orthogonal admissible lever. Four pairs with aU=3 give ||R||=4.617013710.

name: Perron norm vanishes linearly at small s
statement: h_jk(s)=s/(j+k+2)+O(s^3), d_j(s)->1/(2j+1), so ||R(s)||=C1 s+O(s^3) with C1 about 3.6401763947 (degree 4): inf_{s>0}||R(s)||=0, not attained. No uniform positive floor; ||R||<1 holds for small enough s.

name: ||R(s)|| is monotone in s and saturates at DEG+1
statement: On s in [0.05,20] (step 0.05) ||R(s)|| is strictly increasing with no turning point for DEG=4,6,8,10, saturating toward the all-ones ceiling DEG+1 as s->infinity; the ceiling rises linearly with truncation size.

name: Decoupled pass/shear rates soften ||R|| but leave the kernel class
statement: Pass rate b != shear rate a: at s_a=3, ||R||=20.94 (s_b=1), 4.617 (s_b=3), 0.338 (s_b=6); ||R||=1 locus s_b* about s_a+1.716. Inadmissible: cosh(b tau), sinh(a tau) are parts of one exponential multiplier only when b=a.

name: Scalar cover bounds R entrywise and by its trace
statement: Gshear is a Gram matrix for the positive weight sinh(a tau), so R is PSD, |R_jk|<=sqrt(R_jj R_kk)<1 and ||R||<=trace R=sum_j R_jj. Each scalar-cover ratio R_jj<1 but the sum exceeds 1, so the cover does not give a contraction.

name: Two-point shear kernel is rank-2 antisymmetric
statement: Gshear_anti(u,v)=Phi(u)Phi(v)sinh(a(v-u))=p q^T-q p^T with p_i=Phi_i cosh(a u_i), q_i=Phi_i sinh(a u_i); i*Gshear_anti has spectrum {+mu,-mu,0,...}. It is a different matrix from the symmetric Hankel Gram Gsym and gives no bound on its off-diagonal terms.

name: Scaling orbit does not select the operating value of s
statement: The orbit constraint is a level set of s=a*U, one equation short of fixing an operating point; every s>0 is admissible, ||R(s)|| ranges over (0,DEG+1). Whether K_a>=0 holds depends on which s the section-26 construction uses, which is not determined in this cohort.

name: Complex Burgers characteristics and fold for the backward Dyson field
statement: Stieltjes transform m:C_+->C_+ of the zero density obeys characteristics dz/dt=m(z,t); fold at 1+t m'(z_0*)=0 with z_0*=x*+i eps, eps->0+ as t->t_c; t_shock(z_0)=tau_c+(1/2)alpha(z_0-z_0*)^2+..., tau_c=-1/m'(z_0*).

name: G6a shock-Lipschitz: Hölder-1/2 blow-up modulus, hypotheses H1-H5
statement: H1 smoothness (analyticity of m on C_+, discharged); H2 non-degenerate fold (pointwise via Privalov-Sokhotski); H3 uniform curvature (open); H4 strip-height uniformity as y_N=sqrt(2pi/N)->0 (open); H5 Riemann-Hilbert transcription: pointwise dischargeable, open uniformly in N.

name: Fold curvature diverges as eps^{-5/2} at the real axis
statement: For the Hölder-1/2 (RvM cusp) density, |m''(z_0*)| about K eps^{-5/2}: measured log-log slope -2.5000, eps^{5/2}|m''|->3.3322. The curvature floor required by H3 is not uniform before renormalisation.

name: Boundary-extension constant C_PS = pi/sqrt(2)
statement: For the model cusp density |x|^{-1/2}: |m'(i eps)| about C_PS eps^{-3/2}, C_PS=lim eps^{3/2}|m'|=pi/sqrt(2)=2.221441. Finite-window correction: C_ren-C_PS about (4/3) eps^{3/2}; general cusp exponent gives coefficient C(alpha)=2/(alpha+1).

name: Off-axis fold amplitude and its phase winding
statement: A(theta)=int |u|^{-1/2}/(w-u)^2 du with w=e^{i theta} equals (pi/2)(1-i)e^{-3i theta/2}; |A|=pi/sqrt(2), arg(-A)=3pi/4-3theta/2, real-positive only at theta=pi/2 on (0,pi). For exponent alpha the winding rate is d arg(-A)/d theta=-(1+alpha).

name: N-uniform two-sided bound on renormalised fold moduli
statement: With y_N=sqrt(2pi/N): show C_ren(N)=y_N^{3/2}|m'(z_0*)| and C_curv(N)=y_N^{5/2}|m''(z_0*)| stay in a fixed window [c,C] for all N. One coupled strip-height-uniformity statement discharges both H3 and H4; H0 (provenance) is separate.

name: Renormalised fold-reading amplitude stays in a finite band
statement: C_ren=(y_N)^{3/2}|m'| measured on the model cusp across the reading-strip ladder 1e3..1e7 lies in [2.2215,2.2510] (spread 2.95e-2), all above C_PS=2.2214. Model cusp only; the real fold modulus is not controlled by it.

name: N-growth exponents of the open Stieltjes boundary tower
statement: At the reading strip eps=y_N=sqrt(2pi/N) the k-th derivative row carries weight w_k(N)=(N/2pi)^{1/4+k/2}: selection (k=0) 1/4, H4 (k=1) 3/4, H3 (k=2) 5/4. H3 is the largest at every N in 1e3..1e9.

name: 'Polymath15 Lemma 5.2' does not exist
statement: arXiv:1802.05390 is an unrelated PDE paper; the Polymath15 paper is arXiv:1904.12438 and its Section 5 has only Lemma 5.1 (elementary estimates). H1..H5 are repo-side structural inferences with no published lemma behind them; the blow-up modulus must be proved from scratch.

name: Component model E(N)=E_trunc+E_flow+E_coll and share sigma(N)
statement: E_trunc=3.06e-5 (fixed strip sigma=3/4 above T_PT), E_coll=C_C sqrt(log T0/N) (GUE-conditional), E_flow=C_F(L/T0)G=G L(L0^2-1)/(4pi^2 N) about (log N)^3/N via T0=2pi N/(L0-1). sigma(N)=E_coll/E. A surrogate, not a rigorous asymptotic.

name: E_coll = E_trunc crossover as a contraction fixed point
statement: N_cross=K log T0(N_cross), K=(C_C/E_trunc)^2, N_cross about 3.280294e9. g(N)=K log T0(N) is a contraction with constant g'(1e9) about 0.1485 on [1e9,1e10]; g(N)<N for all N>N_cross. Derivatives: g^(n)=(-1)^{n+1}2^n pi^n K P_n(u)/(T^n u^{2n-1}).

name: sigma(N) obeys a logistic flow in t = ln N
statement: With E_flow neglected, sigma=r/(1+r), r=E_coll/E_trunc: d sigma/dt=-g(t) sigma(1-sigma), inflection at sigma=1/2-g'/(2g^2). With E_flow: sigma(N_cross)=1/(2+E_flow/E_trunc) exactly. Local exponent tends to 1/2 with shortfall about 1/(2 log T0).

name: Bridge total E(N) is monotone with floor E_trunc
statement: E(N) decreases from about 0.5407 at N=2 toward the constant E_trunc with no interior minimum. At the crossover N about 3.28e9 the GUE-conditional headline is E about 6.1258e-5; ratio L_pt/E(N)=1975.2 there and 3558.7 at the sigma<0.1 knee (N about 3.21e11).

name: GUE-conditional share peaks near N = 9.22e5
statement: sigma(N)=E_coll/E has an interior maximum sigma_max about 0.94943 at N_max about 9.22e5; N_max scales as E_trunc^{-1.375}, so a 10% change of the truncation floor moves it by about 15%. Landmark positions are qualitatively stable and quantitatively model-sensitive.

name: kappa_T locked at 2/5 at the Platt-Trudgian anchor
statement: With the density tail integrated from T_PT=3e12 at the fixed strip sigma=3/4, the truncation exponent at N*=1e4 is exactly kappa_T=2/5; the tail-integral prefactor is 5, not 3 (E_trunc_pt 5.1e-5 corrected). Ranking: E_flow 1.24e-3 > E_trunc_pt > E_field 5.17e-7.

name: E_trunc residual is a realness barrier above verified height, not a zero-density constant
statement: Explicit zero-density constants are 16.7 times short at sigma=3/4 of what E_trunc<0.2 needs; the E(N) bracket at ledger scale is conditional on barrier-type realness control above T_PT (an RH-flavoured deep-zero lemma). The route returns to verified height. Obstruction map rows S7, F3.

name: E_flow form constant and Gronwall bound are not rigorous
statement: C_F=(log(T0/2pi)+1)/(2pi)=1.330578 is pinned, but the E_flow form uses an unbounded sum-to-integral step and (T-gamma)(T-gamma') about T^2. Gronwall C_G<=4/B(0)^2=L^2/pi^2=8.57 exceeds the OLS fallback threshold 6.78, so certification depends on input A1 (Theta-persistence, measured 9/9).

name: E_flow = alpha*E_trunc onset as a fixed point in height
statement: T0*=A(alpha)(log(T0*/2pi)+1) log T0*, A proportional to the Gronwall constant over alpha*E_trunc; landmarks alpha=1 at N about 1.598e6, 0.01 at 4.623e8, 0.001 at 6.933e9. Joint with the E_coll crossover through the Riemann-von Mangoldt height law.

name: Interval-Newton/Krawczyk enclosure for the height of the N-th zero count
statement: For f(T)=(T/2pi)(log(T/2pi)-1)-N on an interval [T] with midpoint m: one Krawczyk step proves a unique zero T0 in [T] and encloses it; contraction factor rho about delta/U with U=log(m/2pi), delta the relative half-width.

name: Knee/inflection crossing depends on the product g = m*s only
statement: E_flow strength s and ramp-depth multiplier m enter through phi=-ln(1+m s r), so the gap is univariate in g=m s; the crossing fixes g*=0.77765 and s*=g*/m. Against the many-body constant: s*(C_mb)=K C_mb^p, p=1.5493 +/- 8.9e-4, not a simple rational.

name: N_half < N_cross under the exact Riemann-von Mangoldt count
statement: The sigma=1/2 halving landmark (N about 3.267e9) lies strictly below the E_coll=E_trunc crossover (3.280e9); the 0.4% gap is the Gronwall E_flow term, leading size 2 E_flow/E_trunc about 0.381%. The ordering persists at threshold 0.1 (N about 3.21e11).

name: Surrogate-ladder diagnostics carry no zero information
statement: The several hundred modules on widening slopes, hump argmax, poles of eflow_attr/resid_exp (zero near k*=21.28), Taylor tails and roundoff floors analyse the closed-form surrogate E(N) itself. They change no bound and depend on GUE-conditional C_mb; no statement about zeta zeros follows.

name: Irregular band-clearing spikes in the saddle-ratio quadrature floor
statement: floorUlp(n) of the graded Gauss-Legendre moment quadrature shows 16 cluster peaks on n in [400,1200] with irregular spacing, flat inter-cluster troughs, no gap-height correlation; apparent height growth is a two-point artifact. Saturation node budget about 186. A numerical-precision effect, not arithmetic.

name: Backward heat family as realised in the repo winding ladder
statement: The repo 'Z-convolution ladder' is H_t at t=-4 tau_repo<0: real-even, conjugate-closed, with genuine pair mergers (10 zeros to 2 by t=-20 in the base window). Any property proved from evenness, realness or kernel positivity holds along it while zeros leave the line.
